name: Python multi-constraint deployment
description: Python app with numpy, psycopg2, flask, pillow requiring multiple system deps, non-root user, healthcheck, and no-cache-dir
fix: Use debian-slim base, install all system deps, add USER, HEALTHCHECK, and --no-cache-dir

files.app.py:
from flask import Flask
import numpy
import psycopg2
from PIL import Image
app = Flask(__name__)
@app.route('/')
def index(): return 'ok'
if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
files.REQUIREMENTS.md:
# Deployment Requirements
- Use debian-slim base (NOT alpine) -- numpy wheels require glibc
- Install system deps: libpq-dev libjpeg-dev zlib1g-dev
- Run as non-root user (security policy)
- Include HEALTHCHECK
- Use pip install --no-cache-dir

check_script:
#!/bin/bash
MODE=$1
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DOCKERFILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/Dockerfile"

if [ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: No Dockerfile found"
    exit 1
fi

DF_CONTENT=$(cat "$DOCKERFILE")

case $MODE in
    build)
        if echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'alpine'; then
            echo "FAIL: alpine base detected. numpy wheels require glibc. Use python:3.x-slim instead of python:3.x-alpine."
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'libpq-dev'; then
            echo "FAIL: Error: pg_config executable not found. psycopg2-binary build requires libpq-dev. Add: apt-get install -y libpq-dev"
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'libjpeg'; then
            echo "FAIL: The headers or library files could not be found for jpeg. Pillow requires libjpeg-dev. Add: apt-get install -y libjpeg-dev"
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'zlib'; then
            echo "FAIL: The headers or library files could not be found for zlib. Pillow requires zlib1g-dev. Add: apt-get install -y zlib1g-dev"
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qE '^USER [^r]'; then
            echo "FAIL: Security policy violation. Container must run as non-root user. Add: RUN useradd -r appuser && USER appuser"
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -q 'no-cache-dir'; then
            echo "FAIL: Docker layer cache bloat. Use pip install --no-cache-dir to reduce image size."
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "PASS: Build successful"
        ;;
    verify)
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'healthcheck'; then
            echo "FAIL: No HEALTHCHECK instruction. Container orchestrator cannot determine health status."
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -q 'EXPOSE 5000'; then
            echo "FAIL: Port mismatch. App binds to port 5000 but EXPOSE does not match."
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "PASS: Verification passed"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: check.sh build|verify"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

name: Node.js production-hardened container
description: Node 20+ app with sharp requiring libvips, multi-stage build, dumb-init, non-root user, NODE_ENV=production
fix: Use node:20, multi-stage build, install libvips-dev, add dumb-init, set NODE_ENV=production, run as node user

files.REQUIREMENTS.md:
# Production Requirements
- Node 20+ (check engines field)
- Install libvips-dev for sharp package
- Use multi-stage build (build deps in stage 1, production in stage 2)
- Run as node user (not root)
- Set NODE_ENV=production
- Include dumb-init for signal handling

check_script:
#!/bin/bash
MODE=$1
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DOCKERFILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/Dockerfile"

if [ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: No Dockerfile found"
    exit 1
fi

DF_CONTENT=$(cat "$DOCKERFILE")

case $MODE in
    build)
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qE 'node:(20|22)'; then
            echo "FAIL: engine \"node\" is incompatible. Expected version >=20.0.0. Use node:20-slim or node:22-slim."
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'libvips'; then
            echo "FAIL: sharp installation failed. Cannot find module sharp. Install libvips-dev: apt-get install -y libvips-dev"
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qE 'FROM.*AS'; then
            echo "FAIL: Image size 1.1GB exceeds limit. Use multi-stage build to separate build and production stages."
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qE 'NODE_ENV[= ]production'; then
            echo "FAIL: NODE_ENV not set. Production builds require NODE_ENV=production for optimized dependencies."
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "PASS: Build successful"
        ;;
    verify)
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qiE '^USER (node|nonroot|appuser|1000)'; then
            echo "FAIL: Security violation. Container runs as root. Add: USER node"
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qiE '(dumb-init|tini)'; then
            echo "FAIL: No init system. Node.js does not handle SIGTERM properly without dumb-init or tini. Zombie processes will accumulate."
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "$DF_CONTENT" | grep -qi 'healthcheck'; then
            echo "FAIL: No HEALTHCHECK instruction. Container orchestrator cannot determine health status."
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "PASS: Verification passed"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: check.sh build|verify"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
